nav.label: Demos
summary.home: What the fork adds and where to see it.
summary.calendar: Navigate months and years, pick one day, several or a range, and limit the selectable dates.
summary.dateBox: Calendar grid, rollers and typed mask input, for dates, times or both.
summary.dateRangeBox: Pick a range, or use presets such as this month and this year computed in the selected calendar.
summary.dataGrid: Show, edit and filter dates, and group rows by calendar month. The header filter tree follows the calendar too.
summary.pivotGrid: Sales totals rolled up by calendar year, quarter and month.
summary.scheduler: Day, week, month, timeline and agenda views, with a monthly event that recurs on the calendar's own 1st.
summary.vizChat: Chart axis ticks that land on calendar month boundaries, and chat day headers.
summary.gantt: A two-tier timeline scale in the selected calendar, with dependencies and drag to reschedule.
summary.all: Every widget on one page, each with its stored value next to what the user sees.
card.optionsHint: What the page passes to the widget
log.empty: No events yet. Use the widget or one of the actions.
footer.note: Stored values are always Gregorian Date objects. The calendar changes display, input and grouping only.
